source.author: verg
source.text: Tu lacrimis evicta meis, tu prima furentem his, germana, malis oneras atque obicis hosti.
source.text_original: Tu lacrimis evicta meis, tu prima furentem / his, germana, malis oneras atque obicis hosti.
source.text_english: You, conquered by my tears, you first, my sister, overwhelm and throw me, raging as I am, into these troubles, and cast me forth to the foe.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: cui breuiter respondeat ipsa, quae passa est: tu lacrimis euicta meis, tu prima furentem his, germana, malis oneras atque obicis hosti.
reuse.text_original: cui breuiter respondeat ipsa, quae passa est: tu lacrimis euicta meis, tu prima furentem his, germana, malis oneras atque obicis hosti.
reuse.text_english: Let her, who has suffered, answer briefly herself: you, overcome by my tears, you, first, sister, burden my frenzy with these misfortunes and cast me to the foe.
